title: tfscript.json
description: Settings for tfscript, TinyFugue's macro language, outside an editor: the tfscript.* settings without the prefix, plus the Claude Code hook's own. The folder holding this file is the root; relative paths are relative to it.

entryFiles.description: Files tf loads after stdlib.tf, in order: normally just the tfrc. Default: a tfrc, .tfrc or tfrc.tf in this folder, else ~/.tfrc.

contexts.description: Named alternatives to entryFiles, each one way tf might be started, with the files it loads.

activeContext.description: Which of contexts files are seen through. Default: the first.

libraryPath.description: tf's library (TFLIBDIR), holding stdlib.tf. Default: TFLIBDIR from the environment.

tfPath.description: TFPATH as tf starts with it. Default: TFPATH from the environment.

workingDirectory.description: tf's current directory, which relative /load paths resolve against. Default: this folder.

homeDirectory.description: What ~ means to tf. Default: your home directory.

pathMappings.description: Where tf's absolute paths are here, for a tf that runs somewhere else (a container, WSL, a remote host).

tf.description: An absolute path as tf sees it.

variables.description: Variables with a value as tf starts, name to value.

unresolvedLoads.description: Report /load and /require paths tf wouldn't find. Default: true.

undefinedMacros.description: Report calls to macros defined nowhere tf can see. Default: true.

ignoreMacros.description: Macro names the undefined-macro check leaves alone, ignoring case; * is a wildcard.

claudeCode.description: The Claude Code plugin's hook only: how it reports after an edit.

enabled.description: Check the files under this tfscript.json after each edit. Default: true.

warningLimit.description: How many warnings to list; the rest are counted. Errors are always listed. Default: 20.

showInformation.description: List information notes too. Default: false.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a check before giving up with a short notice. Default: 10.
